learningObjectives: Interpret feature importance from trained machine learning models.
Explain individual predictions using interpretable techniques.
Distinguish global model behavior from individual prediction explanations.

activities.title: Explainability Map
activities.instruction: Connect each explainability technique to the type of information it provides.

content.concept: Explainability techniques help describe how a model behaves overall or why it produced a particular prediction.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Shows how important input features are to a model.
Measures how model performance changes when a feature's values are shuffled.
Can attribute a prediction to contributions from individual features.
Describes patterns in model behavior across many observations.
Explains the contribution of features for an individual prediction.

activities.title: Importance Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify which features contribute most strongly to the model's overall predictions.

content.concept: Feature importance provides a measure of how strongly features contribute to model behavior, although the meaning depends on the importance method used.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Global vs Local
activities.instruction: Match each explanation to its scope.

content.concept: Global explanations describe model behavior across the dataset, while local explanations focus on one prediction or observation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Global Feature Importance → Overall model behavior
Permutation Importance → Overall effect of feature disruption
SHAP Explanation for One Record → Individual prediction
Local Explanation → Why one specific prediction was produced
config.answer: Global Feature Importance → Overall model behavior

activities.title: Prediction Breakdown
activities.instruction: Build an explanation showing how feature contributions lead to an individual prediction.

content.concept: Local explanations can represent how individual features contribute positively or negatively to a particular model prediction.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
